fact: APS reports that on 2026-10-06 Algeria's and Niger's ministers launched operation at Assamaka of the fibre-optic trans-Saharan backbone linking In-Guezzam (Algeria) to the Arlit-Agadez region (Niger), with 100 Gbps capacity from the start, to carry data traffic between the two countries.
ANP reports that on 2026-10-06 the ministers of Niger and Algeria presided at Assamaka over the official launch of operation of the trans-Saharan fibre-optic backbone linking Niger to Algeria.

Niger's communications ministry reports that on 2026-10-05 its minister, with Algeria's ambassador and an Algerian technical delegation, arrived in Agadez to launch the works of the Niger-Algeria fibre-optic interconnection.

Niger's communications ministry reports that on 2026-10-06 the Niger-Algeria trans-Saharan fibre-optic link was declared officially operational at a ceremony in Assamaka co-chaired by the two countries' ministers.

On 2026-09-08 Algerie Telecom and Niger Telecom signed a convention in Niamey under which Algerie Telecom donates fibre-optic transmission equipment to set up an Agadez-Assamaka fibre link, to the Algerian border, with an initial capacity of 100 gigabits; the article also reports Niger Telecom receiving the equipment, and does not report works begun or the link lit.
system: Agadez-Assamaka fibre link (Niger-Algeria trans-Saharan fibre-optic backbone)
